title: Remote device that causes defecation

tellings.quote: I know for example, someone that worked on a on a device that uh could make someone immediately have to defecate uncontrollably.

plain: There is said to be a device that can make a person suddenly and uncontrollably need to defecate, apparently from a distance. Dave Rossi, a guest, tells Michels he personally knows someone who worked on such a device, but he does not say who built it or where.
